description: Fetch one Outlook message by its id, including the plain-text body and a web_link that opens it in Outlook. Use it to read a message found with search_outlook_messages, or when a triggering event hands you an Outlook message_id.

account.description: Email address of one connected Outlook mailbox. Omit to use every connected mailbox.

name: get_outlook_message
title: Read Outlook email
